# Natural Brows by Jenn

> Permanent makeup studio in Franklin, Tennessee offering nano brows, powder brows, combo brows, and lip blushing. Owned by Jennifer "Jenn" Hammers. Located inside Tennskin Studio at 443 Cool Springs Blvd, Suite 103, Franklin, TN 37064. Serves Franklin, Brentwood, Nashville, Spring Hill, and Williamson County.

## Key facts
- Services and prices: nano brows $300+ (about 2 hours), powder brows $300 (about 2 hours), combo brows $300 (about 2 hours), lip blushing $200 (about 90 minutes).
- A follow-up touch-up about 6 weeks after a brow appointment is included at no charge.
- Every brow appointment starts with brow mapping: a center line, start, arch, and tail measured from the sides of the nose and the eyes with a pre-inked string, level lines to balance both brows, and a check of how the brows move. The client approves the drawn shape before any pigment.
- Pigment is chosen and adjusted for skin undertone, skin depth, natural and colored hair, and skin type, starting slightly softer so color can be deepened at the touch-up.
- Microblading is not offered; Jenn specializes in machine nano strokes and powder shading.
- Hours: Monday–Thursday and Saturday, 8am–5pm, by appointment. Closed Friday and Sunday.
- Phone: (201) 961-4176. Email: jenn@naturalbrowsbyjenn.com.
- Online booking: https://naturalbrowsbyjenn.glossgenius.com/book
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/naturalbrowsbyjenn

## What clients say (Google reviews, all 5 stars)
- Clients describe Jenn as intentional, thoughtful, and a careful listener who shows options before committing.
- Reviews highlight natural-looking hair strokes, accurate color matching to the client's own hair, and a gentle, pain-free experience for first-timers.
- One client with brow thinning from aging and thyroid issues called the results thrilling; another said the drive to Franklin was worth it.
- All reviews: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Natural+Brows+by+Jenn+Franklin+TN

## About Jenn
Jenn is a lifelong creative with a career in marketing, sales, and customer experience. After having her own brows done years ago and seeing how it changed her confidence, she began creating natural-looking brows. Every appointment starts with detailed brow mapping (measuring start, arch, and tail with string and pencil and balancing both sides) and a pigment blended for the client's skin undertone and hair color. Her goal is for every client to leave feeling more beautiful than when they walked in.
